description: Old London Bridge, a city unto itself

highlights.title: Houses on the Bridge
highlights.text: Old London Bridge was lined with over 130 timber-framed buildings, some rising seven storeys high — making it effectively a street and a neighbourhood unto itself

highlights.title: St Magnus the Martyr
highlights.text: The church of St Magnus the Martyr stood at the northern foot of the bridge, its spire a landmark for river travellers approaching the City of London

highlights.title: Thames River Trade
highlights.text: The Thames was the artery of London's commerce — sailing barges and wherries ferried goods and passengers beneath the bridge's twenty narrow arches daily
